notes.title: Dirty Depot - Location Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Dirty Depot — Battle Drones: Red Rock Resistance Location Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/dab4c735b759b920ed3ff8ac7cbcc607da577214.png[/img]

Rumour has it that the famous drone salesman, Solomon burgundy, has a depot between the Firing Range and the Celerity Speedway. The old man doesn’t seem to have much of a knack for organisation, the whole place feels like a maze of containers!

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*WRj5hVxUP3lw5nSv[/img]

The Dirty Depot contains multiple branching paths and several dead ends, making it hard to navigate. In many cases, you will find yourself trapped by enemies closing in, where you’ll be forced to rely on your combat abilities! The labyrinth may appear simple at first, however, you will quickly learn that there is more than meets the eye…

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*Jh57-FqkYG5ojXJY[/img]

At the centre of the depot you’ll find Solomon’s Office. In this shop you can purchase health and ammo refills, as well as the iconic double barrel shotgun! You’ll only be able to find the shotgun at this specific location so be sure to pay a visit if you need to knock back your enemies with two barrels of buckshot!

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*5Lg-vVub3BVTZWlg[/img]

The dirty depot is constantly changing. There are several cranes and a telehandler that will relocate containers, sometimes blocking off routes through the maze. If you encounter a blocked route you must either wait for the crane to pick up the container and clear the route, or turn back and take a different route. This can create some very intense combat encounters!

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*ymMnHqrAT0HhesNi[/img]

You never know what Solomon might be hiding amongst the odds and ends of the Dirty Depot. Explore the area on release and you may just find some clues… Join our Discord channel and share your thoughts!

notes.title: Types of Enemies - Part 1
notes.content:
[h1]Battle Drones: Red Rock Resistance — Types of Enemies part 1[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/a30c4323301cd34feba04cfb79bc481317291a92.png[/img]

During your journey playing Red Rock Resistance, you will defeat countless enemy drones. There will be many types of enemies in the game — with different weapons and skills. Therefore, it is worth being well-prepared and choosing the right strategy for each type of opponent. Today we will introduce you to the types of drones that you will first encounter in the game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*OyGEHA_7nP-90mr9[/img]

[u]Visit our blogs introducing the [/u][url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/red-rock-resistance-melee-weapons-overview-34dfdc06df1f][u]melee[/u][/url][u] & [/u][url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/red-rock-resistance-ranged-weapons-overview-84adc8e8e9b3][u]ranged[/u][/url][u] weapons available in our game.[/u]

[b]Melee Drone[/b]

This type of drone attacks at close range with a baton. Since it is a short weapon, it’s advantageous to use a ranged weapon to defeat this drone.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*XLWLKMLTmC3FeerM[/img]

[b]Ranged Drone[/b]

This drone attacks with a laser weapon that is relatively fast and has a long range. The laser beam is visible, which makes their attacks more predictable and easier to avoid. However, when drones attack in large groups it might become more difficult to avoid.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*IjM6gDYQvQy089jn[/img]

[b]Heavy Drone[/b]

Heavy Drone is much more challenging than the previously highlighted drones. It attacks the opponent at a closer range. Heavy drones are equipped with special shields that increase defence and reduce damage taken. They also support nearby drones with a defensive aura, making them worthy opponents on the battlefield.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*ifT8nZKVt_Xnt7XR[/img]

[b]Exploding Drone[/b]

Spot an Exploding Drone nearby? It’s best to run! This drone is equipped with bombs that can explode at any moment. Beware! If you come too close to it, your drone’s HP might just take a massive hit!

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*BpV24X_bIT1KOytb[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*m22ehlZAsDfRwEaH[/img]

We hope you found this article about enemy drones interesting! We’ll be sure to do part 2 for other enemy drones you already be coming across!

[b]Come aboard Pilot![/b]

notes.title: Firing Range - Location Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Firing Range — Red Rock Resistance Location Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/640d3a3f5bce6f4c9e21f67b2d6b9702c3b0c3be.png[/img]

In the world of BATTLE DRONES, the UTA is an ammunition paradise. Red Rock is no exception. Near Solomon’s shop where players will first find themselves, is a makeshift firing range set up during the war by the UTA military.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*QWuLmJF2DlcjQ89b[/img]

To reach the Firing range you must first use Dynamite to destroy the boulders that are obstructing the passage from Solomon’s shop. You’ll come across various ramshackle contraptions created for the purpose of honing drone combat, perhaps you can use them to hone your own! You may also come across two crucial upgrade locations where you can upgrade your pistol and purchase additional ammunition.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*UGADMPpoHnv7GyUg[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*QKO8FizFo1BlLkwH[/img]

The upgrade location is disguised as a classic video game arcade machine. This is where you can not only upgrade your Pistol to a Big Pistol but also purchase more ammo, so be sure to check it out! If you want to learn more about guns, specifically pistols, read this article.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*f6FF-AjDE6zyJhFl[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*ZEjC1aab7kSGRlLb[/img]

The map in BD: RRR gives you multiple branching paths to unlock and explore. The Firing Range is one of the early-game areas, be sure to stop off if you’re in need of a powerful handgun in your play style! Choose your path carefully…

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*0swJFF_zhcyiQLL1[/img]

Ready for some target practice?

[b]Come aboard Pilot![/b]

notes.title: In-game Perks for your Drone
notes.content:
[h1]In-game Perks for your Drone (Red Rock Resistance Game Perks)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/2677b5182590f872e9c91beb4fc8e25f80c17d86.png[/img]

In Red Rock Resistance, you can obtain perks during the game to boost your play style. Perks are special benefits that help you during battles with enemy drones.

A different icon represents every perk that you can buy and obtain specific advantages. You can purchase perks using the drone parts you collect after destroying a hostile drone.

For example, you must collect 500 drone parts to buy the [b]Meteoroids[/b] perk (which adds a 10% damage bonus).

Check out the perks below so you’re clued up before our game is released!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*o_42_hdHhj1j-7nE[/img]

[b]Types of in-game perks:[/b]

[b]Meteoroids[/b]

[u]Harness extraterrestrial energy to inflict more damage on enemies.[/u]

Perk type: Damage

Effect: All weapon damage increased by 10%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/22af54a538de96a28f935e9000c8d7ec536bc3e5.png[/img]

[b]Solomon’s Insurance[/b]

[u]If you ever feel your life is in danger Solomon can guarantee you a second chance with his very own drone insurance.[/u]

Perk Type: Revival

Effect: Instantly revives upon death with one health bar (all drone upgrades lost on death, weapon upgrades remain).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/86dbd65d37a7766fa32dfbdb103d9a835bc05726.png[/img]

[b]Bullet King (Coming Soon)[/b]

[u]The king of bullets loves some melee combat, buy this perk and ensure a return of ammunition on every melee kill[/u]

Perk Type: Ammunition Reload

Return of ammunition with each melee kill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/4260503d03205d6c91573098ba86465d0c3f8d80.png[/img]

[b]UTA Flak Jacket[/b]

[u]The UTA sure know how to make a durable drone body, buy their flak jacket and gain 10% damage resistance.[/u]

Perk Type: Resist

Adds 10% resist to all damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/76658a6884e0c83c666f59a5d868410529d13970.png[/img]

[b]Celerity Speed Cream[/b]

[u]Cutting-edge race technology patented by industry leader Celerity gives you increased drone movement speed[/u]

Perk Type: Speed

Effect: Drone Movement speed increased by 10%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/afab24416ba0dfcdaeb0e12f9787c8a968eaf851.png[/img]

What do you think about the perks? Which one is your favourite? Let us know over on our community page!

[b]Come aboard Pilot![/b]

notes.title: Kentaro Island - Location Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Kentaro Island —Red Rock Resistance Location Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/962c34ca8f83164b54b63cb1194a8a9f8d4b3ba2.png[/img]

In Red Rock Resistance, you’ll discover an immersive world full of rich narrative and design. One of the sections of the map you can unlock is Kentaro Island, a beautiful yet deadly environment.

Today we’ll be taking a look at Kentaro Island and the story behind its existence. Don’t let its beauty deceive you, it’s a treacherous zone for our Battle Drone heroes.

Find out more about Kentaro Island below and see it in action.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Our game is coming to Steam. Check out our page and wishlist the game to stay updated on the upcoming launch.[/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*l4vn1rinujT8hgcu[/img]

Kentaro Industries is a Japanese drone manufacturer known for their super effective melee weapons, namely — the Katana. Solomon Burgundy asked some of Kentaro’s top weapon smiths to set up facilities near his drone parts and weapon shop in Red Rock. The humble tradesmen began to terraform the area to create somewhat of a slice of home, however, this radical transformation of the landscape created a deadly hazard…

The island is located close to the starting point of the game. It’s an area that requires the right kind of explosive to unlock… ([url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/red-rock-resistance-explosives-weapons-overview-cacb2582b06]hint: take a look at our explosives blog![/url]). The island is decorated with beautiful Sakura trees, reminiscent of Japanese Festivals in Spring. Here you’ll find picturesque settings with lanterns, buildings and unique draw bridges.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*wmn3pUycrplm4a2t[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*BbvoMgRE3BjOddrO[/img]

The floating islands created in the terraforming process make for an exceedingly difficult combat arena. You must consider not only your enemies but also the risk of falling into the unflyable depths below.

There are multiple upgrade locations that can be found amongst the Kentaro Islands. You can purchase a Katana from the local sword-smith, as well as find a damage-resistant Flak Jacket in the wreckage of a UTA tank. If you want to read more about perks, check out this article.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*M6VwnEw0LqqdXpcU[/img]

This area will test your skill in more ways than one but is more than worth it for the precious resources you may uncover.

Explore the unique location and find out more about the lore surrounding Kentaro Island.

Do you think you have what it takes to get across the Kentaro Islands in one piece? Jump on our community page and share your thoughts!

notes.title: Explosives Weapons Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Red Rock Resistance Explosives Weapons Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/b7ed83d9d548353cae90c3b07d8cba44c7a833f0.png[/img]

You can use a variety of weaponry in the Battle Drones twin-stick shooter. The last articles focused on our [url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/red-rock-resistance-ranged-weapons-overview-84adc8e8e9b3]ranged[/url] and [url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/34dfdc06df1f]melee[/url] weapons, and today, we’ll take a look at the explosives in the game! We will focus on the epic Rocket Launcher and the different types of grenades available.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*kNhwlrRbysgUgFyK[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[b]Rocket Launcher[/b]

Rocket Launcher is one of our most powerful weapons. Rockets travel in a straight line and explode when they come into contact with any object or opponent. Rocket explosions have a broad range with significant AOE damage. This weapon allows you to move freely, the only disadvantage is that there are two rockets in the magazine, so watch out for a longer reload time.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*4dPlH-Dl9Mez7i64[/img][img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*6ntvW9ZFFYYyBWPA[/img]

[b]Basic Grenade[/b]

This grenade deals with a lot of Area of Effect (AOE) damage within a short range.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*tZbYSD5CBCr0lWUJ[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*BZIG__Y5GILhKf2k[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*Qmoep-ixjbLBwrl4[/img]

[b]Cluster Grenade[/b]

As an upgrade of the basic grenade, the Cluster Grenade deals a similar amount of initial damage, but with some extra bonuses. During the explosion, the Cluster Grenade spawns four smaller grenades which detonate in a plus pattern. This gives it a larger explosion radius compared with the basic grenade.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*owdbE3zR8G9EJlPP[/img][img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*YeChMo98om5lCE2I[/img]

[b]Dynamite[/b]

The Dynamite, when detonated, causes a great deal of damage to enemy drones. It sticks to objects and may come in handy for opening up different areas of the map. It has a limited throwing range so watch out for enemies! You’ll find that it’s not the cheapest of items, so be strategic about when and how you use it!

Dynamite explosives will pave the way for you in no time! And don’t worry — the explosion and falling rocks won’t hurt you, so you don’t have to run away.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*ncDRggTueMP9lYaB[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*2Yt6wDzzYg6GKl5k[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*6-o3zVBb2b2a2qOr[/img]

We hope you liked the first article about the Battle Drones explosive weaponry. Keep your eyes out as we introduce new weapons in the future.

[b]Come aboard Pilot![/b]

notes.title: Melee Weapons Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Red Rock Resistance Melee Weapons Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/6938b59a8cd10db80da39468295f5ee7f40a5eda.png[/img]

[url=https://medium.com/@BattleDrones/red-rock-resistance-ranged-weapons-overview-84adc8e8e9b3]Seeing that we’ve covered some of our ranged weapons in Battle Drones: Red Rock Resistance[/url], let’s now take a look at the melee weapons in-game. This article covers the first set of melee weapons you will get to play in the game demo and alpha launch.

There are both melee and ranged weapons, each with its own set of advantages and disadvantages. Melee weapons can deal great damage without limiting your movement or combat speed. However, you’re limited to close-range combat and put yourself at risk for enemy attacks. Ranged weapons have varying attacking distances and power, allowing you to navigate enemy attacks more strategically.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

Today we will focus on three melee weapons: [b]Dagger, Katana, [/b]and the[b] Ultra Great Sword.[/b]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*rvT2sK-QGxvDhZIi[/img]

[h3 name="2de6" id="2de6" class="graf graf--h3 graf--leading"][b]Dagger[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*HEW__l8FD513nIBu[/img]

[b]Characteristics[/b]

[b]Range: [/b]Extremely limited range

[b]Attack speed: [/b]Very[b] [/b]Fast

[b]Attack angle: [/b]120 degrees

[b]Power: [/b]Moderate

The first melee weapon you will use in the game is Dagger, which can be upgraded to Katana. The dagger deals moderate damage, and is a very fast weapon. The cooldown is very short, and that makes it extremely efficient. But of course, it is a small weapon so it has an extremely small range. Dagger has a 120° attack angle.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*d0u79joeNphxkY6n[/img]

[h3 name="bae0" id="bae0" class="graf graf--h3 graf--leading"][b]Katana[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*EQKIPsqVbY_yjhKo[/img]

[b]Characteristics[/b]

[b]Range: [/b]Limited range

[b]Attack speed: [/b]Fast

[b]Attack angle: [/b]120 degrees

[b]Power: [/b]High

Katana deals a lot more damage than the dagger but it needs a little longer cooldown than the dagger. However, its range is a bit longer. Similarly to Dagger, it has a 120° skill angle.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*ciV21IuXMp2yPGz9[/img]

[h3 name="f806" id="f806" class="graf graf--h3 graf--leading"][b]Ultra Great Sword[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*oBxzsZxcBDCIgw9H[/img]

[b]Characteristics[/b]

[b]Range: [/b]Small Range

[b]Attack speed: [/b]Fast

[b]Attack angle: [/b]360 degrees

[b]Power: [/b]Very High

The Ultra Great Sword is a more advanced weapon. It deals more damage than the Katana with the same cooldown time. It has a longer range and you can swing it at a 360° angle. That makes the Ultra Great Sword an amazing AOE weapon! With the 360° attack angle, you can deal damage to opponents all around you with every swing!

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*XKBufPyBLTwxliWh[/img]

We hope that you enjoy the quick overview of the in-game melee weapons.

notes.title: Solomons Shop - Location Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Solomon’s Shop — Red Rock Resistance Location Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/41215f00c3c7a47834fabc82348eec27500b678b.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*9EPrCd_cmq9uaR2Z[/img]

Battle Drones: Red Rock Resistance is a[b] [/b]3D twin-stick shooter set in a fictional reimagined version of Red Rock, New Mexico. Players will find themselves in the desert equipped with nothing more than a military drone, a handgun and a knife to fend off the incoming waves of hostile drones sent from the evil mega-corporation ‘[u]A-EYE[/u]’. Luckily, famous drone parts salesman Solomon Burgundy has a shop nearby! You’ll be sure to pay him a visit if you need new guns, ammo and even drone insurance…

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Our game is coming to Steam. Check out our page and wishlist the game to stay updated on the upcoming launch.[/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*PACEOSGJnf0OOvef[/img]
[b](early WIP in-game screenshots)[/b]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*puc3EFVJa84SxWOZ[/img]
[b](early WIP in-game screenshots)[/b]

[b]Solomon Burgundy[/b]
[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*1Xkj8XEQX4l2mzWp[/img]
Burgundy is a shopkeeper that players can interact with at his in-game store ‘[u]Solomon’s Famous Drone Emporium[/u]’ or ‘[u]Solomon’s[/u]’ for short. It’s not hard to find him — he is usually hovering around the front of the shop to serve customers, unless there are any A-EYE drones in the vicinity, in that case, he may retreat to the safety of his bunker!

Using his connections in the global drone market, Solomon has sourced a collection of parts from all over the world and offered them for sale to the public. Paving the way for common folk to participate in the Battle Drones Championship and a chance at life-changing glory.

[b]Drone Bones Marketplace[/b]

Separate from the in-game store, ‘[u]Solomon’s Famous Drone Emporiu[/u]m’, Solomon is also responsible for the online marketplace ‘[u]Drone Bones[/u]’, where you will be able to purchase new drone parts that can be used to customise your Battle Drones Avatar. With these parts and avatars comes the choice of ownership, allowing you to trade these assets on an open marketplace. More on this soon!

We can't wait to reveal more about many more characters and features within the Battle Drones universe, so stay tuned for future articles! Be sure to keep an eye on [url=https://l.instagram.com/?e=ATPq0UvR7Fp-cgHxvFi8pVqoyD8GTeNqTXBSsxv2Ab03VmDoT6Ehfg6RxYNMapm0OE1F75zypplea0tv&s=1&u=https%3A%2F%2Flinktr.ee%2Fbattledrones]our [/url][url=https://linktr.ee/battledrones]socials[/url] & [url=https://discord.com/invite/s82b8gZF5v]discord[/url] so you know what’s up!

notes.title: Ranged Weapons Overview
notes.content:
[h1]Red Rock Resistance Ranged Weapons Overview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/ee3dce19f846eb80af7916a902340ff3e3b748ae.png[/img]

[u]We take a closer look at some of the ranged weapons available in Red Rock Resistance.[/u]

In Battle Drones, our twin-stick shooter, there is a wide range of weapons for you to use. This article covers some of the first weapon types you will see in the game.

There are both melee and ranged weapons, each with its own set of advantages and disadvantages. Melee weapons can deal great damage without limiting your movement or combat speed. However, you’re limited to close-range combat and put yourself at risk for enemy attacks. Ranged weapons have varying attacking distances and power, allowing you to navigate enemy attacks more strategically.

Today we will focus on three ranged weapons: [b]pistol, rifle, and shotgun.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205520/Battle_Drones_Red_Rock_Resistance/?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=blogs&utm_campaign=growth+campaign&utm_id=2022][u]Great news! Now you can wishlist Red Rock Resistance on Steam! Stay updated on the official game release and special announcements![/u][/url]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*12dPDfXirVXBxk0F[/img]

[h3 name="7331" id="7331" class="graf graf--h3 graf-after--figure"][b]Pistols/handguns[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*xZvLIY-H0xc_SFJt[/img]

[b]Characteristics[/b]

[b]Range: [/b]Average

[b]Firing Speed: [/b]Fast

[b]Reload:[/b] Fast

[b]Power: [/b]Moderate

[b]Ammunition[/b]: Low Capacity

Pistols are low-calibre weapons that fire rapidly but have an average range. Reload time and cooldown are generally short. Therefore, the pistol is considered a quick weapon. Its downside is the fact that it has relatively little ammunition in the magazine and it needs to be replaced frequently, and the range of the weapon is not very large. Deals moderate damage.

[b]Handgun[/b]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*20L3bZoJm_1bvWvy[/img]

[b]Heavy Pistol[/b]

This upgraded version of the first pistol has less ammunition and a bit longer reload and cooldown time. However, it shoots with a longer range and deals more damage.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*j2Pu3ORw-UtcTMf4[/img]

[h3 name="0da2" id="0da2" class="graf graf--h3 graf-after--figure"][b]Assault Rifles[/b][/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*f6upkgeHlFgtqZkz[/img]

Rifles are versatile guns that have large magazines, short cooldown time and satisfactory damage within mid-range. Reload time and cooldown are short. The rifle is a very fast, deadly weapon. It has a very large magazine and a greater range than a pistol. However, it deals slightly less damage.

[b]Range: [/b]Long

[b]Firing Speed: [/b]Very Fast

[b]Reload:[/b] Very Fast

[b]Power: [/b]Low

[b]Ammunition[/b]: High Capacity

[b]Base Assault Rifle[/b]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*CVmBcteCb6XG70f8[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*f6upkgeHlFgtqZkz[/img]

The upgraded assault rifle has the same specifications, however, it deals a bit more damage. Plus, it has a laser pointer making it easier to aim at the target.

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*rdCwSxNg2fDhoLk7[/img]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*H-FBxW_jxyXJZCXJ[/img]

[h3 name="4448" id="4448" class="graf graf--h3 graf-after--figure"]Shotgun[/h3]

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*2klkvEIZ-LOm4_OT[/img]

The shotgun deals immense damage with massive power, however, at a short distance. Also, it has only two pieces of ammunition in the magazine and a long reload time. The shotgun is able to pierce up to three targets, and pushes the enemy backwards!

[b]Characteristics[/b]

[b]Range: [/b]Short

[b]Firing Speed: [/b]Slow

[b]Reload:[/b] Very slow

[b]Power: [/b]Very[b] [/b]High (multi-hit & push back)

[b]Ammunition[/b]: Very Low Capacity

[img]https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/800/0*YENXOC6voB4_-Ahb[/img]

We hope that you liked the first article about the Battle Drones weaponry.
